releaseNotes: 重新适配 WorkBuddy 5.3.5；统一优化 WorkBuddy、豆包与 Codex 的输入区、会话选中态和发送/停止按钮；挂件改为按皮肤横向移动并在边缘掉头；修复重复或固定挂件、单套永久授权文案歧义及解锁弹窗异常背景。
releaseNotesEn: Adds verified WorkBuddy 5.3.5 support; refines composer framing, selected conversations, and send/stop controls across WorkBuddy, Doubao, and Codex; makes mascots traverse and turn around per theme; and fixes duplicate or stationary mascots, single-theme entitlement wording, and the oversized unlock dialog background.
